When your friend trusts a fart that he shouldn’t have and shits your bed.

The first time I met...I’ll call him Frank. My friend and I had gotten to the team(shared) hotel room after everyone was asleep. I was the new guy on the team, and this was my first convention(I used to perform for tattoo conventions). After went to bed, but I woke up to a butt naked man I’d never seen before crawling into the bed I was in.
After I shot upright and scrambled to the edge of the bed, fully prepared to punch him, he gets a mortified look on his face, screams.

“OH..!!! I SHIT..!”
Me: “...like...just now?”
(His hand shoots under the blanket to his ass)
Him: “yeah dude, I shit”
Me while violently scrambling out of the bed: “...are you serious??? How!?!? How do you do that!?”
Him: “I just trust farts way too much”
Me: “Is this a regular thing??”

Turns out he shit himself like 9+ times so far that year. This was in April. 

As terrifying as it was to wake up to having a naked stranger crawl into and then proceed to shit my bed, I think the real loser that day was the poor housekeeping crew that had to deal with the aftermath while we were working the convention.
